title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 5: a report about the assembly, a little yeast in the whole lump, the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth, and who judges those outside.

questions.text: What does verse 1 say was reported about the assembly?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says it is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among them.

answers.text: That there was sexual immorality among them
That they had stopped meeting together
That they had turned back to idols
That they had refused to keep the feast

questions.text: How does verse 2 describe their attitude, instead of mourning?
questions.explanation: The verse says they are arrogant, and did not mourn instead.

questions.text: How does the writer say he is present, though absent in body?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says he is absent in body but present in spirit, and has already judged the matter as though he were present.

questions.text: According to verse 6, what does a little yeast do?
questions.explanation: The verse asks whether they do not know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump.

answers.text: It is lost in the whole lump

questions.text: Who is called "our Passover", who has been sacrificed in our place?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says that indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

questions.text: With what does verse 8 say they should keep the feast?
questions.explanation: It says to keep the feast not with old yeast, nor with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

answers.text: The old yeast of the fathers
Bread and wine from the assembly
The unleavened bread of sincerity and truth

questions.text: Why does verse 10 say he did not mean the sexual sinners of this world?
questions.explanation: The verse says that if he had meant them, you would have to leave the world.

answers.text: Because the world does not listen
Because then you would have to leave the world
Because they belong to another assembly
Because they had never heard the Good News

questions.text: What does verse 11 say about sharing a meal with such a person?
questions.explanation: The verse says not to associate with such a person, and adds, "Don't even eat with such a person."

answers.text: Eat with him only at home
Do not even eat with him
Eat with him before the assembly

questions.text: According to verse 13, who judges those who are outside?
questions.explanation: The verse says that those who are outside, God judges.

questions.text: With what quoted words does the chapter end?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 ends with the words, "Put away the wicked man from among yourselves."

answers.text: "Let all things be done decently and in order."
"Put away the wicked man from among yourselves."
"Be imitators of me, even as I am of Christ."
